gate_outcome_note: Accepted at the parent gate on 2026-08-23. Session ses_fd0588026ffeeqKlyb4vrGP1Ym, exit 0, 50 events, one 9,477-character final finalized on the first invocation. Read-only boundary held and no verification command was run, as instructed. The parent verified every load-bearing claim against the repository and all matched: the strictly sequential ladder loop at scripts/verify.mjs:389, fullyParallel false at playwright.config.ts:87, fileParallelism false at vitest.integration.config.ts:10, retries 0 at playwright.config.ts:89, the absent expect timeout in the playwright expect block, and - decisively - the ratified unit-step precedent at vitest.config.ts:23-26 whose own comment states this exact diagnosis. The stage overturned the hypothesis the slice was activated on: the mechanism is timeout headroom against a sequential ladder, not concurrency contention. It also answered the discriminating question the brief demanded, explaining the unit step rarity by its already-raised 20000ms budget, and it declined to claim the class can be retired by configuration alone. Two imprecisions, neither affecting the conclusion: the expect block was cited as :103-110 when it is :102-104, and nine hardcoded waits were listed where there are eight. The parent REJECTED the return's second proposed change - integration testTimeout - as unnecessary under the smallest-necessary-change constraint, because no observed failure ever hit vitest's integration testTimeout and its justification divided total step time by test count, conflating setup with execution.

execution_split: Recorded, not improvised. The orchestrator takes the baseline ladder measurements itself and the delegated worker never runs the ladder. The reason is a data boundary, not capability: every meaningful ladder measurement needs real .env credentials and a disposable database, dotenv_contents is an excluded payload class under both durable authorizations, and a failing ladder run's output is exactly where credential values would surface. Doing the measurement inline removes that exposure entirely rather than relying on redaction discipline. What crosses to the worker is summarized evidence — step names, durations, test counts, and failure file:line locations — which carries no excluded class. The split is one-way: measurements are produced first and handed in as input, so the stage is not an iteration loop and inspection is not coupled to implementation.

This is disclosed in the slice contract and was NOT used as a direct-execution reason. playwright.config.ts, vitest.config.ts and vitest.integration.config.ts were not opened by anyone before this decision was recorded.
